past_queries.question: What is the refund rate?
past_queries.sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM payments p), ref AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM refunds r) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT total FROM pay) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST((SELECT total FROM ref) AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM pay) END AS refund_rate

past_queries.question: What is the dispute rate?
past_queries.sql: WITH dsp AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM disputes d), inv AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM invoices i) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT total FROM inv) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST((SELECT total FROM dsp) AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM inv) END AS dispute_rate

ask_revenue_by_city.sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT c.city AS city, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM payments AS p JOIN invoices AS i ON p.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.city), ref AS (SELECT c.city AS city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM refunds AS r JOIN invoices AS i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.city), cities AS (SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers) SELECT cities.city AS city, COALESCE(pay.total, 0) - COALESCE(ref.total, 0) AS revenue FROM cities LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.city = cities.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

avg_invoice_value.definition: Average invoice amount in the given period.

dispute_rate.definition: Disputes opened as a share of invoices issued: COUNT(disputes) / COUNT(invoices).

gross_revenue.definition: Gross revenue before refunds: total payments received, ignoring refunds.

refund_rate.definition: Refunds as a share of payments received: SUM(refunds) / SUM(payments).

refunds.definition: Total amount refunded to customers in the given period.

revenue.definition: Net revenue after refunds: total payments received minus total refunds, in the given period. Amounts in paise; divide by 100 for rupees.
